id: \bI wonder if I should sneak around back and train there?
en: \bI wonder if I should sneak around back and train there?
it: \bChissà se dovrei intrufolarmi sul retro e allenarmi lì.

id: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bThrough here you battle Spenser. Are you ready?
en: \bThrough here you battle Spenser. Are you ready?
it: \bDa qui si va a lottare contro Spenser. Sei pronto?

id: \rThis is too much for me. I never thought I would have to participate.
en: \rThis is too much for me. I never thought I would have to participate.
it: \rÈ troppo per me. Non avrei mai pensato di dover partecipare anch'io.
